name: SillyTavern 1.19 AI Chat and Character UI
description: Power-user chat UI for any LLM: characters, lorebooks, extensions, login.

PORT.description: Port SillyTavern listens on (0.0.0.0). Railway's healthcheck and the public domain use it; keep 8000 unless you also change the domain's target port.

ST_ADMIN_HANDLE.description: Login handle of the admin account, generated at deploy (random so it cannot be guessed; the login page does not list accounts). a-z, 0-9 and dashes.

ST_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Admin password (min. 12 characters), set on the first boot. Change it here and redeploy to reset it; a password changed in SillyTavern is kept until then.

SILLYTAVERN_ENABLEDISCREETLOGIN.description: true hides the account list on the login page, so handles must be typed. Keep it on unless every handle is hard to guess.

SILLYTAVERN_ENABLESERVERPLUGINS.description: Server plugins run as Node code inside SillyTavern with access to all users' data and API keys. Set true only for plugins you have reviewed.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Seconds SillyTavern gets after SIGTERM to save usage stats and exit cleanly before a redeploy stops it.
